settings.heading: I learned this the expensive way.
settings.body:
I grew up around Lagos market. Long before I sold anything myself, I was watching how it actually works: who buys what, who gets a good price, and who walks away with a box of stock nobody wants.

In 2016 I started a small bridal accessories business. I had a bag of stock and a WiFi connection, and no idea what I was doing. I bought the wrong things. I priced them wrong. I listed on the wrong platform and decided the product was the problem. Every one of those lessons cost me money, and I learned each one on my own, because there was nobody to ask who wasn't also trying to sell me something.

That business became GBL Accessories. GBL Accessories became GBG Wholesale Hub. Same eye for product, but built into something with the part I never had: someone to ask.

That is why the guides are free and why I answer messages myself. Not as a marketing tactic. Because I remember what it cost not to have them.

Input equals output. We can hand you the stock and the roadmap. The rest is yours to build.
